sequence_join: Exact IRES ID join, one Metadata record per ID and unique IRES ID x Cell line in activity. Accession ID/Start/End/Sequence are all in the same workbook. No external sequence join required.

measurement_vs_prediction.Predicted probability: LAMAR model probability; not experimental translation.
measurement_vs_prediction.Raw Activity: Observed reporter output normalized against modified-mRNA reporter control according to article Methods; not raw luminescence.
measurement_vs_prediction.Score: Deterministic log10(Raw Activity * 100000 + 1), matches every worksheet row.
measurement_vs_prediction.replicates: Article says two replicates. Workbook contains one value per IRES ID x Cell line, with no replicate identifier, replicate-level values, uncertainty, or explicit aggregation rule.

cell_label_cautions: Workbook has 'Neruo-2a ' including trailing space (likely Neuro-2a; preserve original label until mapping documented).
scope_limits: These are IRES insert sequences in a shared circRNA reporter context, not complete independent circRNA designs.
The same sequence is repeated across cells; do not treat 3915 pairs as 3915 independent sequence examples.
Contains 305 viral-derived candidates and 13 cell contexts; model training must group sequence-related records and account for source and assay differences.
No imputation was performed; exactly 25 IDs lack both Neruo-2a and U87 values.

Three metadata records (IDs 92, 135, 275) have sequence length unequal to End-Start+1. This audit does not infer the reason. Use the supplied Sequence column and exact IRES ID join; do not silently reconstruct sequences from accession coordinates.
